name: Koike Mei
source:
"Do you remember Valentine's Day in fifth grade?"

A tsundere girl who excels in both academics and sports! A reliable childhood friend heroine. But not very good at cooking...? Lately, she's been feeling anxious because the distance between the protagonist and the popular senior student is getting shorter.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250518184944/https://g.28gou.net/valentinus/#characters]official website[/url]]
